model_notes: This is a construction change order (No. 3) to Agreement TL-KIT-2025 for the Tamarack Lodge Kitchen Expansion. The $17,480.00 price change and the 4 working day time change are the change itself; the document gives no original contract sum, prior change total or revised contract sum, so the arithmetic check cannot be run. The change order has no issue date of its own; the only date is the agreement date of 12 March 2025.
